author: htnabe
description: My new blog which describes my current situation
name: t-pot

scripts.linkcheck:md: find content -type f -name '*.md' -print0 | xargs -0 lychee --cache --no-progress --max-concurrency 32 --timeout 10 --base-url https://htnabe.github.io/ --accept 200..=299,403,429 --accept-timeouts --exclude '^file://'
scripts.linkcheck:md:changed: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT origin/main...HEAD -- 'content/**/*.md' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -r lychee --cache --no-progress --max-concurrency 32 --timeout 10 --base-url https://htnabe.github.io/ --accept 200..=299,403,429 --accept-timeouts --exclude '^file://'
scripts.linkcheck:md:staged: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=ACMRT -- 'content/**/*.md' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -r lychee --cache --no-progress --max-concurrency 32 --timeout 10 --base-url https://htnabe.github.io/ --accept 200..=299,403,429 --accept-timeouts --exclude '^file://'
scripts.update:theme: hugo mod tidy && hugo mod get -u github.com/htnabe/HikaeMe/v2 && hugo mod npm pack && npm install
